inserter.endpoints.pickup_drop_tiles is documented-only, not observed in a controlled game capture. Pickup and drop tiles follow the prototype's pickup_position [0, -1] and insert_position [0, 1.2] rotated by the entity direction, so a north-facing inserter takes from the tile one south and drops one north. Documented wiki behaviour adds that an inserter dropping onto a belt places items on the far lane. Arcs relying on it are relaxed, never exact.

inserter.rate.cycle_and_stack is documented-only, not observed in a controlled game capture. Throughput is cycles per second times hand size. The wiki gives roughly 0.86 cycles/s for the inserter and 2.5 cycles/s for the fast and bulk inserters at normal quality, and hand size grows with inserter capacity research, which the blueprint does not record. The prototype exposes only extension_speed, rotation_speed and the bulk flag, so no items/s follows from it. Arcs relying on it are relaxed, never exact.

machine.activity.assembling_machine_2 is documented-only, not observed in a controlled game capture.
